messages:
katie: Quick sync 0 we need final assets for AWS, GCP, Azure listings by EOD. Legal docs, AMIs/containers, pricing SKUs, and support contact. Status?
raj: Legal uploaded T&Cs + privacy addendum to the drive. Still waiting on SOC2 evidence from infra. Also need to confirm EU data residency blurb for listings.
marco: Pricing: drafted SKUs and tiers for dev/standard/professional/dedicated. Need product confirmation on trial length and trial quotas before finalizing prices.
sara: Ingest: prepping staging buckets and manifest template. Use naming: `redwood-listing/<provider>/<ticket>/manifest.json`. Example: `gs://redwood-marketplace/ingest/gcp/1812354321/manifest.json`.
alex: Hit a 403 on AWS staging earlier 0 fixed IAM (s3:PutObject) and pushed a PR for the role change: https://git.internal/r/perms/1238
jen: Support/docs: need canonical support alias, SLA blurb, and onboarding runbook link to include in the listing.
raj: Support alias: `marketplace-support@redwood.ai`. SOC2 expected from infra by EOD tomorrow; for EU residency we can say "data processed in EU regions only" when we list specific regions.
katie: OK on residency wording. Marco, lock trial to 14 days as product requested.
marco: 14-day trial is fine. Proposing trial caps: 2k token-equivalent requests/hour and 5 concurrent sessions. Will update SKUs.
sara: Manifest template below 0 paste logo URLs and artifact IDs into `image_urls` / `artifact_ids`. Also include `support_email` and `trial_days`.
sara: ```
{
  "provider": "AWS|GCP|Azure",
  "name": "Redwood Inference",
  "image_urls": ["https://assets.redwood.ai/logo-512.png"],
  "artifact_ids": ["ami-0a1b2c3d","gcr.io/redwood/inference:stable","azure:container:67890"],
  "pricing_skus": ["DEV-1","STD-1","PRO-1","DED-1"],
  "support_email": "marketplace-support@redwood.ai",
  "trial_days": "14"
}
```
alex: AWS note: include `snapshot_id` and `instance_type_recommendation` per region since AMIs are regional.
raj: Legal: avoid unapproved marketing claims (e.g., "enterprise-grade"). If we list SLA-like guarantees, we need sales-ops sign-off.
marco: Will avoid explicit SLA language for public listing until sign-off.
jen: For support runbook, include an escalation path and pager rotation link. Can we attach the runbook URL to the manifest?
katie: Yes, include runbook link after Marco finalizes SKUs. I'll run validation once manifests are uploaded.
sara: Validation command: `python tools/validate_manifest.py --file manifest.json --provider aws`. Upload targets: `s3://redwood-marketplace/ingest/aws/1812354321/manifest.json`, `gs://redwood-marketplace/ingest/gcp/1812354321/manifest.json`, `https://blob.azure.net/redwood/ingest/azure/1812354321/manifest.json`.
alex: IAM fix applied, AWS upload succeeded. I pushed the initial manifest to `s3://redwood-marketplace/ingest/aws/1812354321/manifest.json`.
deploy-bot: Task created: marketplace/ingest/1812354321 0 checklist: legal artifacts, manifest upload, SKU confirmation, runbook link. Assignee: partnerships-katie. https://tasks.redwood.ai/marketplace/1812354321
katie: Plan for today: Raj follows SOC2, Marco finalizes SKUs & pricing, Jen scaffolds runbook, Sara validates manifests after upload. If green, request publisher account review EOD. :thumbsup:
raj: I'll chase infra/legal and update when SOC2 is in the drive.
marco: Updating pricing doc now and will ping here when SKUs are final.
jen: Runbook scaffolding will be posted in ~90 minutes.
sara: Running final validation now. Post any manifest changes before 18:00 PT.
katie: Also: please prefix artifact filenames with ticket id `1812354321_` to help tracing. Thanks!
